Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Cummy
Description:
Pair with someone over tells, then right-click them to layer cum onto a body part. Layers stack on top of their own current skin (Bibo body), are published through Penumbra so sync plugins show them to everyone, and stay until cleaned or dried off.
Requires Penumbra. 18+ content.
Punchline: Cum layering system for your paired partners.
Changelog:
- New Public mode (Settings, General, Who can layer me): anyone with Cummy nearby can layer or lick you without pairing, and you can layer anyone nearby. Pairing mode, the default, works as before. Your blocks and range still apply.
- New blacklist: blacklisted players can never layer, lick or invite you until you remove them. Add people in settings by Name@World, or hold Ctrl and click Blacklist in the droplet menu. Blacklisting a partner unpairs them.
- The right-click Cummy menu is gone. Use the droplet button instead: it shows whenever someone is nearby and lets you pair, layer, lick or blacklist them. Clean yourself from /cummy or with /cummy clean.
